user.title: Add a device
user.description: Keep the generated API key private. It will be copied into that device's agent configuration. Create one entry per phone or PC. Points and the wake alarm follow this entry's child, not another device.

data_description.windows_username: The chore-manager child this device belongs to. Use that child's name. Each phone has its own device id and API key.

error.invalid_device_id: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

init.title: Device blocker options
init.description: Wake alarm, parent controls, screen assessment, and Android media backup. The wake alarm is Android-only and is read on the phone's usual state poll. Volume is 0–100, where 100 is that phone's maximum alarm-stream volume. S3 credentials stay in Home Assistant. Leave a secret field blank to keep its saved value.

data.clear_screen_credentials: Clear saved VNC and Kilo credentials
data.media_backup_enabled: Enable Android photo and video backup
data.clear_s3_credentials: Disable backup and clear saved S3 credentials

data_description.wake_alarm_enabled: The person holding the phone can stop a ringing alarm. Changing the time, days, or volume is done here.
data_description.wake_alarm_volume: 0 is silent. 100 is the phone's maximum alarm-stream volume.
data_description.screen_schedule_mode: Manual creates only the Check screen now button. Fixed and random also run automatically.
data_description.kilo_base_url: Leave unchanged to use the documented Kilo Gateway default.
data_description.kilo_model: The official balanced automatic route is kilo-auto/balanced.
data_description.s3_prefix: Objects are stored below this prefix. Every upload requires external power; the initial library sync also requires unmetered Wi-Fi.

error.random_range: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
error.invalid_provider_url: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.invalid_s3_endpoint: Enter an HTTPS S3 origin without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_s3_bucket: Enter a valid DNS-style S3 bucket name.
error.invalid_s3_region: Enter a valid S3 region such as us-east-1.
error.invalid_s3_prefix: Enter a folder prefix containing at least one safe path segment.
error.android_only: Media backup can be enabled only for an Android device entry.
error.parent_pin_too_short: Use a parent PIN with at least four characters.
error.required_when_enabled: This value is required when screen assessment is enabled.
error.invalid_wake_time: Enter a wake time as HH:MM.
error.wake_days_required: Choose at least one day when the wake alarm is on.
error.invalid_wake_volume: Alarm volume must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
